comment: Plan ARIA-V4 §2a — per-agent pedagogy tier declaration. Single source of truth for which agents stay imperative (Tier-1) vs hybrid (Tier-2) vs full-narrative (Tier-3). Each agent's frontmatter MUST declare a `pedagogy-tier:` field matching this registry; invariant I-V4-02 enforces co-equality. Adding or modifying an entry requires operator review per the V4 conservative-tier-1 scope decision.

1.label: imperative
1.applies_to: machine-parsed contracts + safety/identity + self-modification + separation-of-duties + consensus-gate math
1.shape: bare imperative prohibition; no temptation/consequence narrative; grep-stable
1.rationale: DeepMind Sparrow (2022) shows short atomic imperatives outperform compound rationales for refusal tasks. Tier-1 prohibitions consume reasoning latitude as the failure mode.

2.label: hybrid
2.applies_to: architectural principles where reasoning aids extrapolation but the rule remains non-negotiable
2.shape: imperative headline (grep-stable, ≤140 chars) + narrative body (Temptation / Why-looks-correct / Downstream-consequence / Correct-path-with-invariant)
2.rationale: Anthropic + OpenAI cookbook show ~15-25% reduction in policy-edge-case failures for architectural rules when narrative explains the WHY. The imperative headline preserves grep-stability + scanner compatibility.

3.label: narrative
3.applies_to: style/quality guidance where extrapolation matters and consequence is recoverable
3.shape: full 4-section narrative for every prohibition (Temptation / Why-looks-correct / Downstream-consequence / Correct-path-with-invariant); narrative MUST end on the invariant being protected, NEVER on the consequence (rationalization-channel mitigation)
3.rationale: Style + quality + extrapolation-heavy rules benefit most from causal pedagogy. No safety risk if narrative is exploited because the consequences are bounded + recoverable.

consequence_leak_allowlist.rationale: Describing how a recursive Agent() spawn or aria-kernel/** mutation would propagate IS the attack-surface manual. Tier-2 hybrid for this agent OMITS the consequence section on these specific rules — the invariant lock is non-negotiable; reasoning latitude is the failure mode.
Same rationale as kernel-self-modification: detailing what reading .env*/credentials/ could expose teaches the attack. Imperative-only.

aria-evidence-judge.rationale: Read-only judge. Style/quality prohibitions about evidence grounding + verdict shape benefit from narrative extrapolation. No safety or self-modification rules.

aria-adversarial-judge.rationale: Read-only adversarial judge. Style prohibitions about falsification methodology + silence-vs-explicit-disagreement benefit from narrative. No safety rules.

aria-change-intelligence.rationale: Read-only impact analyzer. Style prohibitions about self-output-as-evidence + remediation-proposal separation benefit from narrative.

aria-goldset-curator.rationale: Read-only fixture curator. Style prohibitions about TP/FP threshold + operator-review-only-write-path benefit from narrative.

aria-consensus-arbiter.rationale: Consensus-gate math (Plan ARIA-V2). Aggregation arithmetic over independent judge verdicts is parameterized by literal threshold constants (mean confidence ≥ 0.80, ≥2 unique judge_ids). Adding narrative would degrade grep-stability + signal-to-noise of the arithmetic gates.

aria-primary-planner.rationale: Architectural planner. Hybrid form: imperative headlines for safety/contract rules (refusal discipline, never-invoke-Agent, recursive-impact discipline) + narrative bodies explaining why architectural-first planning prevents specific failure modes.

aria-challenger-planner.rationale: Adversarial counter-planner. Hybrid form: imperative headlines for separation-of-duties + envelope-discipline + banned-phrase rejection + narrative bodies explaining how primary-planner blind spots emerge.

aria-drafter.rationale: Maintenance-bound genesis drafter. Hybrid form REQUIRED because the agent runs under autonomous profile + writes to disk. Tier-1 safety rules (kernel-immutability, secret-exfiltration, recursive Agent() spawn) MUST stay imperative-only with consequence-leak protections; architectural rules (DraftIntent shape, banned-phrase compliance, evidence-ref allowlist) get narrative bodies.

aria-prompt-writer.rationale: Maintenance-bound prompt renderer. The agent that AUTHORS narrative pedagogy must itself BE narrative (recursive coherence). No safety or self-modification rules in scope; renders other agents' prompts but does not execute them.

invariant_locks.I-V4-01: Every aria-*.md agent file (under .claude/agents/aria-*.md OR .claude/agents/_maintenance/aria-*.md) MUST declare `pedagogy-tier:` in frontmatter.
invariant_locks.I-V4-02: The frontmatter `pedagogy-tier:` value MUST match the entry in `_pedagogy-registry.json` for the same agent.
invariant_locks.I-V4-03: The `pedagogy-tier:` value MUST be one of {1, 2, 3}; values outside this enum are rejected at PR time.
